data.name: MemberSince
data.comment: MT — gender-invariant: replaces the participle «pridružio se», which forced a masculine subject the directory cannot know; no personal noun is used either. Structure diverges from bg deliberately: {0} is an opaque pre-formatted year-month in the nominative («srpanj 2026.») and .NET has no genitive year-month pattern, so «U igri od {0}» would render «od srpanj 2026.». The colon puts {0} in a nominative slot. Terminology matches NavCharactersRegistered («registriran»).
